description_en: Updates a knowledge base synchronization link
kebab_example: aliyun polardb update-kb-sync-link --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --knowledge-base-id pkb-xxxxx --link-id pkbl-xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateKBSyncLink

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization link
parameters.name: link_id

parameters.help_en: The automatic synchronization interval, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 自动同步间隔，单位为分钟
parameters.name: sync_interval_minutes

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize deletions from the source
parameters.name: source_delete_sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic synchronization. This parameter can only be modified individually and cannot be changed along with other configurations
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用自动同步，仅支持单独修改，不可与其他配置同时变更
parameters.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: The new Lark user access token
parameters.help_zh: 新的飞书用户访问令牌
parameters.name: user_access_token

parameters.help_en: The new Lark user refresh token. It must be provided together with UserAccessToken. Passing two empty strings indicates deletion
parameters.help_zh: 新的飞书用户刷新令牌；与 UserAccessToken 同时传入，两个空字符串表示删除
parameters.name: user_refresh_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DingTalk operator
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the successful Lark group member snapshot used for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter can only be explicitly set for Lark synchronization links. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 disables snapshot fallback reuse. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of the snapshot allowed for reuse. If omitted, the original value is retained. Explicitly passing -1 restores the default behavior
parameters.help_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路可显式设置；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；省略时保持原值，显式传入 -1 可恢复默认行为
parameters.name: feishu_chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the successful group member snapshot used for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter applies to DingTalk and Lark synchronization links. If this field is explicitly configured, it takes precedence. If not configured, Lark uses FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 disables snapshot fallback reuse. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of successful snapshots in the same workspace, enterprise, and group allowed for reuse. If omitted, the original value is retained. Explicitly passing -1 restores the default behavior
parameters.help_zh: 群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。适用于 DINGTALK、FEISHU 同步链路；显式配置本字段时优先使用本字段，未配置时飞书沿用 FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的同空间、同企业、同群成功快照的最大年龄；省略时保持原值，显式传入 -1 可恢复默认行为
parameters.name: chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk Docs MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉文档 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: mcp_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk Sheets MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉表格 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: sheet_mcp_endpoint

parameters.help_en: This parameter applies only to DingTalk sources and must be set together with SelectionRules. Valid values: ALL: Synchronizes files in the source directory that are not excluded by excludes. The includes parameter must be an empty array. SELECTED: Synchronizes only files that match includes and are not excluded by excludes. If includes is empty, no files are selected. If this parameter is not provided, the original configuration is retained. If both parameters are provided, the original rules are replaced. This parameter cannot be modified at the same time as SyncEnabled. The new configuration takes effect starting from the next synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于钉钉来源（DINGTALK），须与 SelectionRules 同时设置。ALL：同步来源目录内未被 excludes 排除的文件，includes 必须为空数组。SELECTED：仅同步 includes 匹配且未被 excludes 排除的文件；includes 为空时不选择任何文件。不传时保留原配置；同时提供两个参数时替换原规则。不能与 SyncEnabled 同时修改。新配置从下次同步开始生效
parameters.name: selection_mode

parameters.help_en: The file path filtering rules in JSON format. It only contains two required string arrays: includes and excludes. Paths are relative to SourceDir, and exclusion rules take precedence. GLOB is supported: * and ? do not cross directories, and ** matches zero or more directory levels when it occupies a path segment alone. The two arrays can contain a maximum of 256 entries in total. Each entry must be 1 to 512 characters in length. The maximum size of the JSON text is 65,536 UTF-8 bytes. After a file is removed from the synchronization scope, the corresponding documents imported by this synchronization link are cleared, without affecting the source files and documents of other synchronization links
parameters.help_zh: JSON 格式的文件路径筛选规则，仅包含 includes、excludes 两个必填的字符串数组。路径相对 SourceDir，排除规则优先。支持 GLOB：* 和 ? 不跨目录，** 独占路径段时匹配零到多级目录。两数组合计最多 256 条，每条长度为 1～512 个字符，JSON 文本最大为 65536 个 UTF-8 字节。移出同步范围后，将清理本同步链路已导入的对应文档，不影响源文件和其他同步链路的文档
parameters.name: selection_rules

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk AI Tables MCP server. An empty string indicates deletion
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉 AI 表格 MCP Server 地址，空字符串表示删除
parameters.name: ai_table_mcp_endpoint

SelectionMode.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围模式

SelectionRules.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围规则
